cards.ex: I can't make up my mind where to go on vacation this year.
cards.exUz: Men bu yil ta'tilda qayerga borishga qaror qila olmayapman.
cards.uzDef: Bir qarorga kelmoq, aniq bir fikrga to'xtamoq.

cards.ex: I need to figure out how to fix this problem.
cards.exUz: Men bu muammoni qanday hal qilishni aniqlashim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Bir narsani tushunib yetmoq yoki yechimini topmoq.

cards.ex: I'm weighing up the pros and cons of taking the job.
cards.exUz: Men ishga kirishning ijobiy va salbiy tomonlarini baxolayapman.
cards.uzDef: Har bir tomonni ko'rib chiqib, afzallik va kamchiliklarni solishtirmoq.

cards.ex: I'm still on the fence about whether to sell my car.
cards.exUz: Men mashinamni sotish yoki sotmaslik haqida hali ham ikki o't orasidaman.
cards.uzDef: Biror qarorga kelishga qiynalayotgan, ikkilanayotgan holat.

cards.ex: We need to draw up a detailed plan for the project.
cards.exUz: Biz loyiha uchun batafsil reja tuzishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Reja, hujjat yoki shartnoma tuzmoq, tayyorlamoq.

cards.ex: Buying that house was a snap decision, and I regretted it later.
cards.exUz: Uyni sotib olish tez qaror edi va keyin afsuslandim.
cards.uzDef: O'ylamasdan, birdaniga qabul qilingan qaror.

cards.ex: Are you going to go ahead with your travel plans?
cards.exUz: Siz sayohat rejalaringizni davom ettirasizmi?
cards.uzDef: Biror rejani amalga oshirishni davom ettirmoq, boshlamoq.

cards.ex: He backed out of the deal at the last minute.
cards.exUz: U oxirgi daqiqada kelishuvdan voz kechdi.
cards.uzDef: Oldindan kelishilgan narsadan voz kechmoq, ortga qaytmoq.

cards.ex: Let's just play it by ear and see what happens.
cards.exUz: Keling, shunchaki vaziyatga qarab ish tutamiz va nima bo'lishini ko'ramiz.
cards.uzDef: Oldindan rejalashtirmay, vaziyatga qarab harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: The schedule isn't set in stone yet; we can still make changes.
cards.exUz: Jadval hali qatiy emas; biz hali ham o'zgartirishlar kiritishimiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: O'zgartirib bo'lmaydigan, qatiy qabul qilingan qaror.

cards.ex: I'm in two minds about whether to accept the offer.
cards.exUz: Men taklifni qabul qilish yoki qilmaslik haqida ikkilanayapman.
cards.uzDef: Qaror qabul qilishda ikkilanmoq, ikkita fikrda bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: You need to think through the consequences before you act.
cards.exUz: Harakat qilishdan oldin oqibatlarini o'ylab ko'rishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani yaxshilab o'ylab ko'rmoq, har tomonlama baholamoq.

cards.ex: What's our game plan for the presentation?
cards.exUz: Taqdimot uchun rejamiz qanday?
cards.uzDef: Biror maqsadga erishish uchun tuzilgan reja.

cards.ex: Don't put off until tomorrow what you can do today.
cards.exUz: Bugun qila oladigan ishingizni ertaga qoldirmang.
cards.uzDef: Biror ishni keyinga qoldirmoq, vaqtni cho'zmoq.

cards.ex: You can opt out of the program if you want to.
cards.exUz: Agar xohlasangiz, dasturda qatnashmaslikni tanlashingiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Biror ishda qatnashmaslikni tanlamoq, voz kechmoq.

cards.ex: Can I run my idea by you?
cards.exUz: Men o'z g'oyamni sizga aytib maslahatlashsam maylimi?
cards.uzDef: Biror fikrni boshqa odamga aytib, uning fikrini so'ramoq.

cards.ex: We'll cross that bridge when we come to it.
cards.exUz: Unga duch kelganimizda o'sha muammoga yechim topamiz.
cards.uzDef: Muammo yuzaga kelganda uni hal qilish haqida o'ylamoq.

cards.ex: On second thought, I don't think I'll go to the party.
cards.exUz: Ikkinchi fikrda, men partiyaga bormayman deb o'ylayman.
cards.uzDef: Fikrini o'zgartirganda, yangi fikrga kelganda ishlatiladi.

cards.ex: We need to stick to the budget if we want to finish the project.
cards.exUz: Agar loyihani tugatmoqchi bo'lsak, byudjetga rioya qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Reja, qoida yoki qarorga qat'iy rioya qilmoq.

cards.ex: I'll leave it up to you to decide what to do.
cards.exUz: Nima qilishni hal qilishni sizga topshiraman.
cards.uzDef: Qaror qabul qilish huquqini boshqa odamga topshirmoq.

cards.ex: Don't make a decision now. Sleep on it.
cards.exUz: Hozir qaror qabul qilmang. Bir kecha o'ylab ko'ring.
cards.uzDef: Qaror qabul qilishdan oldin bir kecha o'ylab ko'rmoq.

cards.ex: It's a tough call, but I think we should invest in the new technology.
cards.exUz: Bu qiyin qaror, lekin menimcha yangi texnologiyaga sarmoya kiritishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Qabul qilish qiyin bo'lgan qaror.

cards.ex: We set out to create the best product on the market.
cards.exUz: Biz bozorda eng yaxshi mahsulotni yaratishni maqsad qildik.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani maqsad qilib qo'ymoq, harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: I didn't want to get up early, but I had to bite the bullet and go to work.
cards.exUz: Men erta turishni xohlamadim, lekin tishni tishga qo'yib ishga borishim kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Yoqimsiz vaziyatni sabr bilan qabul qilmoq.

cards.ex: The company has a blueprint for expanding its business.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning o'z biznesini kengaytirish uchun rejasi bor.
cards.uzDef: Batafsil reja yoki loyiha.

cards.ex: We need to map out our strategy for the next quarter.
cards.exUz: Biz keyingi chorak uchun strategiyamizni rejalashtirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Batafsil rejalashtirmoq, yo'nalishni belgilamoq.

cards.ex: I need to sort out my finances before I can buy a house.
cards.exUz: Uy sotib olishimdan oldin moliyaviy ahvolimni tartibga solishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni hal qilmoq, tartibga keltirmoq.

cards.ex: I usually just go with the flow and see what happens.
cards.exUz: Men odatda shunchaki oqimga ergashaman va nima bo'lishini ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatga moslashmoq, o'zgarishlarga qarshilik qilmaslik.

cards.ex: I think you're jumping the gun by assuming they'll accept our offer.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, ular bizning taklifimizni qabul qilishadi deb o'ylashga shoshilyapsiz.
cards.uzDef: Vaqtidan oldin harakat qilmoq, shoshqaloqlik qilmoq.

cards.ex: As the manager, she gets to call the shots.
cards.exUz: Menejer sifatida u qaror qabul qilish huquqiga ega.
cards.uzDef: Qaror qabul qilish huquqiga ega bo'lmoq, buyruq bermoq.
